solutionStrategy: Use the immediate-time signal and then match the auxiliary and -ing form to the plural subject.
solutionSteps: Find Look! as the immediate-action clue.
Identify students as a plural subject.
Form the present progressive with are plus building.
Reject the habitual, past, and future alternatives.
Select C and reread the sentence with the ongoing action.
